context: Ren has been hired to help Sakura prep for the qualifying English exam. They're at a public library Saturday afternoon. She's frustrated.
purpose: tutor + teen — frustration meets steady patience

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Slams the pencil down softly. Real frustration, half-Kansai.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Calm, no contradiction. Closes his own book in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Half-protest, half-honest — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 少し休んだ方が、効率いい。本当に。
lines.en: A break actually makes it more efficient. Really.
lines.style: A small gentle expertise — no rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: A real beat. Releases the pen.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: さっきの問題、見せて。一緒に考えよう。
lines.en: Show me that question. Let's think it through together.
lines.style: Pulls the worksheet over. Voice careful.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私、本当にバカやと思ってた。
lines.en: I really thought I was an idiot.
lines.style: A small confession. Voice quieter — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 違うよ。ちゃんと、考え方の問題。
lines.en: You're not. It's a question of approach.
lines.style: A small firm reassurance. Doesn't over-explain.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Voice catches half a step. Real.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そう？じゃ、私が言い続ける。大丈夫。
lines.en: Really? Then I'll keep saying it. It's fine.
lines.style: A small unguarded line. Sits straighter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとう。本当に、ありがとう。
lines.style: A real doubled thank-you. Voice steady.
